date_scope_check.qualification_retained: Reuters's May 3 footage and employee interview support operation that day and a reported February 28 onset. An indexed IRNA account instead gives February 25. More materially, an April 28 ISNA report reproduced by Arman Eqtesadi quotes the Iranian customs spokesman saying Shoushmi opened that day; a May 4 Alsumaria official account corroborates May 3 formal reopening. Preserve these conflicting claims and withhold the complete continuous duration until their scope is reconciled. Passenger chronology remains unestablished.
